products.name: Deepgram
products.note: Speech recognition API; real-time transcription; model customization; on-prem option

profile_text.body:
Deepgram is a voice AI company that provides speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent APIs aimed at enterprise customers. The company describes itself as "the industry's voice AI leader" and positions its platform around unifying those three capabilities, along with LLM orchestration, into a single API in order to reduce complexity, latency, and cost. It offers real-time transcription, model customization, and an on-premises deployment option, and its site notes an integration with Amazon Connect.

A recent addition to Deepgram's product lineup is Flux TTS, described on its site as a text-to-speech model built for live conversations that "thinks before it speaks," maintaining tone, expression, and continuity across a conversation. The company was offering free access to Flux TTS through September 12th, with up to 45 concurrent streaming connections in the US and 5 in the EU and Australia. The held facts record Deepgram's core offering as a speech recognition API with real-time transcription, model customization, and an on-premises option, consistent with what the company's site presents.
